en_US.title: Brine Canyon Pump Cathedral POI Kit
en_US.scanner: POI kit: pump cathedral reads brine density and old evacuation timing in the same room.
en_US.terminal: PUMP CATHEDRAL KIT: density sightglass, pump scars, accepted margin note, route hold clock and worker queue ledger.

en_US.external_site: The brine pump cathedral is an example of HECTON-8's design rule: machines are navigation, survival and evidence at once.
en_US.field_note: POI evidence kit: Brine Canyon Pump Cathedral turns mid-depth industrial scale into the liability chain's physical landmark.
